Guidance on rest breaks for anyone flying with an animal
What you should know comes first
Rest breaks for anyone flying with an animal

When you travel with a pet, rest breaks should be planned with care so the journey stays calm and orderly. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk works with the ground team to keep carriers secure, movement measured, and handoffs clear.

Before departure, review your travel documents and confirm that your animal can remain settled in its carrier for the full service interval. If your route includes a connection, advise the desk early so staff can guide you on the safest pause points and any transfer support that may be needed. Keep food, water, and comfort items packed so they remain easy to reach when you are able to offer them.

During the journey, follow crew direction and keep the carrier closed unless staff instruct otherwise. A quiet resting place helps reduce stress, especially for animals that are sensitive to noise or change. If your pet shows signs of discomfort, tell the nearest team member without delay so the situation can be handled carefully.

On the ground, our staff move carriers between services with steady attention and checked handling. We rely on concise guidance, kind communication, and practical steps that protect both passengers and animals. If you are traveling with a pet such as Nibbles, make sure the carrier is labeled clearly and remains in your possession until a team member requests it.

For any special concern, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel so we can advise you on the best arrangement.
